_about: Defaults for safe_json.py (AGENTS.md Rule 0): how Denisse's own data files are read, written and locked. Change a value in safe_json.json (same keys); json_config checks it against this file.
_replace: Windows refuses os.replace while another process has the target open (a reader, an antivirus scan). Retry this many times, this many seconds apart, before giving up.
_read: The same for a read that hits PermissionError mid-replace. A file that stays unreadable raises; it is never read as empty.
_lock: with locked(path): takes an OS lock on <path><lock_suffix>. The OS drops it when its holder dies, so a lock file left by a dead process never blocks. A live holder is waited on for lock_wait_seconds (polled every lock_poll_seconds); after that the caller goes ahead with one log line rather than lose the save.
_temp: The temp file a save writes before os.replace: same folder, {name} is the data file's name.
_corrupt: A file that exists but won't parse is copied aside before its default is returned. {stem} and {ext} are the file's name split at the extension; {stamp} is UTC time in corrupt_stamp_format.
